name: Oregon (OR-OSHA)
metric_note: Oregon triggers on heat index (apparent temperature), which combines air temperature with relative humidity. A temperature-only feed CANNOT evaluate this pack. Scorched reports it as unsatisfiable rather than silently substituting ambient temperature, which would under-report every humid day.

thresholds.name: Heat illness prevention duties
requirements: At least one adequately shaded area, or equivalent alternative cooling where shade is not feasible
Free cool drinking water, kept between 35°F and 77°F, caffeine-free supplements only
Written heat illness prevention plan, emergency medical plan and acclimatisation plan
thresholds.evidence_note: Applies indoors as well as outdoors. Exempt if a mechanical ventilation system holds the indoor heat index below 80°F.

thresholds.name: High-heat practices and rest break schedule
requirements: Written rest break schedule in force for the portion of the shift at or above a 90°F heat index
Communication with lone workers, or a mandatory buddy system, or equivalent observation
Designated and equipped workers authorised to call emergency medical services
thresholds.evidence_note: Rest break minimums escalate with the heat index. Confirm the current Appendix A table before relying on specific durations.
